title: Leviticus 16:21 — Aaron confesses sins over the live goat
summary: Adds Leviticus 16:21 under the Exodus 34:26 verse: Aaron lays both hands on the live goat, confesses all the wrongdoings of the sons of Israel over it, and sends it into the wilderness by a man who stands ready. Book names are colour-matched with their Hebrew headings.

text.text: 26 “The first of the firstfruits of your land you shall bring to the house of the LORD your God. You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.”

21 Then Aaron shall lay both of his hands on the head of the live goat and confess over it all the wrongdoings of the sons of Israel and all their unlawful acts regarding all their sins; and he shall place them on the head of the goat and send it away into the wilderness by the hand of a man who stands ready.
